text:
zoe-sales: Heads-up — CascadeAI's CISO paused the POC. They need a time-limited VPC peering plus a short high-throughput window for an exec demo tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Also want a hard spend cap and a simple audit trail. Need ops/security signoff ASAP.

harry-eng: Ok. We can enable peering + kbps uplift and pre-warm KV cache. What's the CIDR and demo duration?

zoe-sales: CIDR 198.51.101.0/26. Demo 14:45-15:30 UTC. Customer ok with up to $1,800 for the demo.

mina-ops: We can create a 3h TTL peering and an egress override. Draft ACL below, keeping it minimal:

```
peering_id: cascade-demo-26
from_project: redwood-sales-demo
to_cidr: 198.51.101.0/26
allowed_ports: [443]
duration_hours: 3
egress_limit_mbps: 40
acl: ["198.51.101.12/32","198.51.101.13/32"]
logging_kms_alias: "alias/cascade-demo-logs"
```

lucy-security: Checklist: TLS-only, customer KMS alias for logs, retention 45d, SSO read-only for their reviewer. I can fast-track if ops adds the exact /32 hosts and the runbook link.

mina-ops: Adding runbook RB-11897 and exact /32s in ticket. Deploying staged peering in eu-west-1.

infra-bot: [change-request] cascade-demo-26 requested by mina-ops. Runbook RB-11897 created.

harry-eng: Two engineering asks: 1) enable KV warmup 10min before window; 2) set model routing fallback to hosted to avoid demo flakiness. Mina, can you configure both?

mina-ops: On it — KV warmup cron scheduled, fallback route set to hosted-primary. smoke test to follow.

grant-csm: I can approve the $1,800 capped demo. I'll send the PO confirmation to procurement and copy legal for the SOW addendum.

mina-ops: Staged deployment done. Smoke from restricted host: TLS handshake OK, synthetic requests successful, median latency 105ms with warm cache.

lucy-security: Reviewing staged ACL + runbook. Conditions met: KMS alias set, retention=45d, SSO access provided. Signing off. :white_check_mark:

mina-ops: Deploying live peering now. infra-bot shows deployment -> live.

infra-bot: [deploy] cascade-demo-26 live in eu-west-1. Runbook RB-11897 status: live -> monitoring.

harry-eng: Verified demo route and fallback. Latency looks stable ~110ms. KV warmup working.

zoe-sales: Thanks everyone. Grant, please confirm it's ok to bill if burst is used.

grant-csm: Confirmed. Billing cap set to $1,800. PO email sent to customer.

mina-ops: Teardown scheduled 16:00 UTC (30min after demo). Will revert egress and remove peering then.

infra-bot: [reminder] teardown job for cascade-demo-26 scheduled at 16:00 UTC.

mina-ops: Teardown complete. Peering removed, egress overrides reverted, logs archived to customer KMS alias. Closing thread.

zoe-sales: Great work — I'll update CascadeAI and mark the POC ticket resolved. :rocket:
